stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy dispenses Provigil and later evaluates a refill. Select all supported conclusions.

choices.text: Schedule IV refill timing and count limits apply.
Covered dispensing must be reported to MassPAT.
The prescription expires five days after issue.
The pharmacist may create a new prescription after five refills.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. A Schedule III or IV prescription may not be filled or refilled more than six months after issue and may not be refilled more than five times unless renewed by the practitioner. Covered pharmacies report dispensing of Schedule II through V controlled substances and DPH-designated additional drugs, including gabapentin, to the Massachusetts PMP under the current submission standard. modafinil (Provigil) is used for improve wakefulness in narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea, or shift-work disorder. It is federal Schedule IV and Massachusetts Schedule IV; its legal consequence in this scenario follows the cited schedule-specific rule.
